Each entry names the volume/image group (007936749 and 007936752), place (Schuylkill, Pennsylvania), record type (Probate Records), coverage dates (1851–1890 and 1891–1930), and image range examined (00001–00015 and 00001–00018). The notes explain the target (Thomas Flynn will, death 1885–1895) and why each film is relevant to the death window. Scope is clear and auditable; no fabricated details.
